1.explanation:
1. Slider.js: where the read-only prop and conditional render logic (hide thumb, disable input) must be implemented.  
2. Slider.stories.js: to add playground controls for toggling read-only state and verify visual changes.  
3. Slider.test.js: where RTL tests should assert the presence of a “read-only” CSS class and absence of the thumb in that mode.  
4. _slider.scss: the SCSS file where the read-only styles (colors, borders, spacing) need to be defined against the design tokens shown in the images.  
5. Slider.mdx: the top-level storybook/MDX document that shows Color, Typography and Structure sections and should include a live read-only example.  
6. Slider/docs/overview.mdx: the Carbon design-system guidelines for Slider layout/spacings, to confirm all measurements match the spec.
1.bug_scenario:
Both design-spec images show a “read-only” variant of the Slider that: 

• Renders the track and label exactly like the enabled Slider, but hides/disables the thumb handle entirely.
• Displays the current numeric value in a non-editable (read-only) input box or tooltip, styled with the correct background, border and typography tokens ($border-strong-01, $text-primary, transparent, etc.).
• Maintains all spacing measurements (8px, 16px, 40px) between label, track and value box as per Carbon guidelines.

In the current implementation the read-only prop is missing (or missing styles), so the Slider still renders a handle and/or an editable input, and does not match the color, border or layout tokens shown in the spec art.
